opalcompat.screen.off: No shader pack: VulkanMod Reforged draws on its own.
opalcompat.screen.pending: %s loads with the next frame of a world.
opalcompat.screen.restart: This needs a restart: the game started with an empty shaderpacks folder, and terrain carries what packs read only when a pack is there at startup. The choice is saved.
opalcompat.screen.hint: Left click: next   Right click: previous   Shift + click: the pack's own value
opalcompat.toast.detail: %s is off, details under Shader Packs.
opalcompat.page.shaders.tip: Draw the world with the chosen shader pack. Off, VulkanMod Reforged draws on its own. Takes effect on Apply.
opalcompat.page.textures.tip: Animated textures get their next frame only once something has drawn with them. Saves the uploads for the hundreds of animated textures of a mod set that are nowhere in sight. Turn off if a texture that should move stands still.
opalcompat.compat.vulkan.title: VulkanMod Reforged settings
opalcompat.compat.vulkan.hint: Renderer, shader packs and these settings are together on one screen.
